info.title: .NET Clean Architecture API launcher
info.description: Creates a .NET 10 HTTP API on Clean Architecture from the CleanArch.WebApi.Templates package by asking for each option, or adds a web app or a web package to a project it generated: dnx CleanArch.Create.

commands.name: new
commands.description: create a project from cleanarch-webapi (the default outside a project)

commands.name: web-app
commands.description: add a web app to the project around the current folder (cleanarch-webapp)

commands.name: web-package
commands.description: add a package to its web workspace (cleanarch-webpackage)

options.name: --name
options.description: the project, app or package name

options.name: --yes
options.description: take the default of every option not given

options.name: --template-source
options.description: install the templates from a checkout or a .nupkg instead of nuget.org

options.name: --hive
options.description: the template engine's settings folder (dotnet new --debug:custom-hive)

options.name: --help
options.description:
show this help
Every option of the template is a flag of the same name, e.g. --auth none --examples none.
Without a terminal, every answer is a flag, or --yes takes the defaults.
